title: Freddy's Hot Drinks (Remix of Nightmare by Tuesday Knight)
description:
A remix of "Nightmare" by Tuesday Knight (Opening song for A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master) in the style and instruments of the iconic "Wendy's - Hot Drinks" port by mmBeefStew. This remix is scarier than Freddy Krueger! Don't forget the power glove!

This was originally posted to SiIvaGunner under the name
"Hot Drinks - Grand Poo World 3"
